chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: The 1947 Cavalcade of Jazz lineup and Toni Harper
summary: Willard goes through the ads and photos in the program, including Toni Harper, whom Austin McCoy taught at Music Town, T-Bone Walker, Slim Gaillard, Teddy Buckner and Joe Liggins.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Probably something he and Gladys had. Uh, and there was the Bronze Recording Company. Uh, I guess that had something to do with War Perkins. And, uh, it's interesting that in 1947 in this program for the Cavalcade of Jazz--Toni Harper was...
Yeah. We used to teach little Toni up there. Austin used to teach her up there at our place. Yeah.

Oh. Looks like she's about six years old here. And there's a picture of Gladys and Lionel. And Mabel Scott was appearing with the Blenders featuring Jimmie Grissom at the Downbeat on Central Avenue...An ad for T-Bone Walker at the Last Word on Central Avenue.
And this was a period when there was a lot of music going on. The Cresbar, Twenty-Ninth and Western.
Creswell's place that later became the Milom.

And there's a picture of Slim Gaillard playing the vibes with Lionel Hampton. And you recognize who...they don't have names on those [pictures of] musicians. You recognize who those people are in that band?
I don't know. That looks like...uh...no, I can't remember. I can't see 'em. Don't it give the names of them there anywhere?
Well, they've got some of them on the program--the people who are appearing...
You see, Heflin might...that might have been a out-of-town band that he just had that cut and put it on there.

I wondered. Because it lists the names of people who were appearing on this particular show but I don't recognize the people in that band. For this particular show, Woody Herman was master of ceremonies, and then they had the Valdez Orchestra. , I don't know who that is. The Blenders, which is some group that had Jimmie Grissom in it; T-Bone Walker; The Honey Drippers, which would be Joe Liggins; Slim Gaillard; Johnny Otis and his Orchestra; Toni Harper; and then Woody Herman and Sarah Vaughan, and the 3 Blazers. And...the Blenders...
Well, they've got both here, but the Blaz...er, the Blenders--here's Teddy Buckner. I recognize him, but I don't know
who the other people are. And it looks like Jimmie Grissom down there but...see that picture? It says the Blenders on it but I don't know who the other musicians are...except for Teddy Buckner.
Teddy Buckner's in the middle there. And this is Liggins here.
Yeah, but the group down in the lower righthand corner of the page--I only recognize two people in it, and they don't have any other names.
